description: Read your workspace's sales playbook (Settings > Sales playbook) and what pricing and negotiation read from it: for each field, what was read or why it could not be, the price band it sets (the floor is the list price less the maximum discount; the ceiling is the list price less any volume or annual commitment discount the buyer is entitled to), the terms buyers see on every counter-offer, and a worked example. released says whether the sales-playbook-pricing release is on: while it is off the playbook is saved and nothing prices from it. Needs a Last Price credential with routing read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: get_sales_playbook
